cmd: pwd && ls -la
echo "===== MAIN.TEX ====="; cat main.tex; echo; echo "===== SYNONYMS.TXT ====="; cat synonyms.txt
cat main.tex
cat input.tex
head -45 synonyms.txt
which pdflatex && pdflatex --version | head -3

mkdir -p /app/work && cd /app/work && cp ../main.tex ../input.tex ../synonyms.txt . && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > compile.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT: $?"; grep -c "Overfull" compile.log; grep "Overfull" compile.log | head -30
grep -A 3 "Overfull" compile.log

cd /app/work && python3 -c "
import re
log = open('main.log').read()
# show each overfull with following context line
for m in re.finditer(r'Overfull \\\\hbox \(([\d.]+)pt too wide\) in paragraph at lines ([\d-]+)\n(.*?)\n', log):
    print(m.group(2), m.group(1), '|', m.group(3)[:100])
"
which python python3 python3.11 perl awk; ls /usr/bin | grep -i -E "python|perl" | head
apt-get install -y python3 2>&1 | tail -3 || apt-get update 2>&1 | tail -2
cd /app/work && echo "#" > reps.txt && perl iter.pl reps.txt 2>&1 | tail -25
sed -n 36,41p iter.pl | cat -A | head -20
sed -n 30,38p iter.pl | cat -A

cd /app/work && perl -i -pe 's/for \(my \$i=0; \$i<@of; \$i\+=2\) \{ print "\$of\[\$i\]\\\\n    \$of\[".*, \$i\+1, "\]\\\\n"; \}/for (my $i=0; $i<@of; $i+=2) { print $of[$i], "\\n    ", $of[$i+1], "\\n"; }/' iter.pl && sed -n '39p' iter.pl && perl -c iter.pl
cd /app/work && sed -i '39c\    for (my $i=0; $i<@of; $i+=2) { print $of[$i], "\\n    ", $of[$i+1], "\\n"; }' iter.pl && sed -n '39p' iter.pl && perl -c iter.pl
cd /app/work && sed -i "33c\\system(q{pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > /dev/null 2>&1});" iter.pl && sed -n '33p' iter.pl && perl -c iter.pl && perl iter.pl reps.txt

cd /app/work && cat > reps.txt <<'EOF'
curious,odd
riotous,wild
excursions,trips
responsiveness,reaction
temperament,mood
weatherbeaten,worn
pathfinder,scout
EOF
perl iter.pl reps.txt
awk '/He did.n.t say any more/,/parcelled out unequally at birth/' test.log
awk '/@firstpass/{p=0} /unsought/{p=1} p' test.log | head -50
awk '/say any more/{f=1} f{print} /at birth\./{if(f)exit}' test.log
grep -n "inclined to reserve\|veteran bores\|unjustly accused\|secret griefs\|communicative in a" test.log | head; grep -n "@firstpass" test.log | head -12
sed -n '182,300p' test.log
grep -n "did.n.t\|bores\|politici" test.log | head
sed -n '72,181p' test.log
sed -n '72,140p' test.log
sed -n '44,74p' test.log
sed -n '72,80p' test.log

cd /app/work && cat > base.txt <<'EOF'
curious,odd
riotous,wild
excursions,trips
responsiveness,reaction
temperament,mood
weatherbeaten,worn
pathfinder,scout
EOF
cat > cand.txt <<'EOF'
unknown,strange
victim,prey
victim,subject
communicative,open
communicative,expressive
communicative,talkative
communicative,articulate
communicative,forthcoming
reserved,quiet
reserved,modest
reserved,withdrawn
habit,custom
abnormal,unusual
abnormal,deviant
abnormal,aberrant
abnormal,irregular
abnormal,atypical
quick,fast
quick,rapid
quick,swift
college,school
college,academy
quality,trait
quality,feature
veteran,dated
veteran,vintage
wild,chaotic
EOF
for c in $(cat cand.txt); do
  { cat base.txt; echo "$c"; } > try.txt
  out=$(perl iter.pl try.txt 2>&1 | grep -E "OVERFULL COUNT|NO OVERFULLS" | head -1)
  echo "$c => $out"
done

cd /app/work && cat > base2.txt <<'EOF'
riotous,wild
excursions,trips
responsiveness,reaction
temperament,mood
weatherbeaten,worn
pathfinder,scout
reserved,quiet
EOF
perl iter.pl base2.txt 2>&1 | grep -E "REPLACE|OVERFULL|NO OVERFULLS"

cd /app/work && grep -v "excursions,trips" base2.txt > tryA.txt && grep -v "riotous,wild" base2.txt > tryB.txt && echo "--- A: no excursions->trips (keep riotous->wild)"; perl iter.pl tryA.txt 2>&1 | grep -E "OVERFULL|NO OVERFULLS"; echo "--- B: no riotous->wild (keep excursions->trips)"; perl iter.pl tryB.txt 2>&1 | grep -E "OVERFULL|NO OVERFULLS"

cd /app/work && cat > sol.txt <<'EOF'
riotous,wild
responsiveness,reaction
temperament,mood
weatherbeaten,worn
pathfinder,scout
reserved,quiet
EOF
for r in $(cat sol.txt); do grep -v "^$r\$" sol.txt > tryX.txt; echo "--- remove $r =>"; perl iter.pl tryX.txt 2>&1 | grep -E "OVERFULL COUNT|NO OVERFULLS"; done
cd /app/work && perl iter.pl sol.txt && diff input.orig.tex input.tex

cd /app && cp work/input.tex input.tex && rm -f main.pdf main.log main.aux && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > compile_out.log 2>&1; echo "PDFLATEX EXIT CODE: $?"; echo "---"; grep -c "Overfull" main.log; grep -i "overfull" main.log; echo "---"; tail -5 compile_out.log
cd /app && sed -i 's/\$i=@wo while/\$i++ while/' verify.pl && perl verify.pl
cd /app && grep -n "reserved\|quiet" synonyms.txt; echo ---; tr ',' '\n' < synonyms.txt | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -d
cd /app && cat -n verify.pl | sed -n '1,30p'
cd /app && sed -i '6i close_placeholder' /dev/null; perl -i -pe 'if (./open my \$b/ && !done) { s/close \$b;/close $b; $\/ = "\\n";/ }' verify.pl; grep -n '\$/' verify.pl; perl verify.pl
cd /app && sed -i '5a\$\/ = "\\n";' verify.pl && sed -n '4,7p' verify.pl && perl verify.pl

cd /app && md5sum main.tex work/main.tex synonyms.txt work/synonyms.txt input.orig.tex 2>/dev/null; ls -la; echo "=== FRESH COMPILE ==="; rm -f main.pdf main.log main.aux && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "EXIT CODE: $?"; echo "--- overfull check:"; grep -ci "overfull" main.log || echo "0 overfull warnings"; echo "--- underfull check:"; grep -c "Underfull" main.log || echo "0"; echo "--- errors:"; grep -c "^!" main.log || echo "0"; echo "--- pdf:"; ls -la main.pdf && tail -3 main.log

cd /app && rm -f compile_out.log && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode main.tex 2>&1 | grep -E "Output written|^!" ; echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; grep -c "Overfull" main.log; echo "overfull count above"; ls -la /app
